content:
Sam: heads-up — us-west canary started throwing 503s at 11:12, deploybot auto-paused today's slot per incident rule. thinking we need to decide hotpatch vs full reschedule.

deploybot: Slot 6421 paused by policy (incident: canary 503 spike). Current slot state: PAUSED. Canary traffic -> 0%. Monitors: cpu spike + kernel OOM logs.

Priya: thanks. do we know if the change in this rollout touched the kvm/kv-cache kernel flag?

Miguel: yes, the canary included the new kernel-selection tweak (kvcache-async=on). Initial logs point to regressing RU on a small subset of nodes.

Elaine: implications for notes/comms — if we hotpatch we need a short postmortem blurb + rollback instructions pinned to the release note. If we reschedule, need coordinated customer comms.

Sam: options:
- hotpatch control-plane only (risk: may not fully exercise path)
- rollback canary -> stable (need DB migration check)
- reschedule entire release window and run full validation later
Which do we prefer for minimal customer impact? :thinking_face:

Priya: hotpatch feels reasonable if patch is limited to kernel tweak revert and we confirm no DB schema changes. Miguel, can infra produce an async quick patch?

Miguel: I can prepare a hotpatch PR and a canary-only rollback plan. ETA ~25m for PR + validation. If tests pass, we can roll to canary, then unpause slot.

ops-bot: Quick checklist:
• confirm no schema migrations in this deploy
• capture canary logs to s3 (s3://redwood-ops/canary/1718754321)
• tag release as "hold-incident-1718754321"
• notify on-call for rollback window

Sam: confirmed — no schema migrations in this change. Miguel proceed with hotpatch PR. Priya, please draft short customer-facing note that we might delay wider rollout if hotpatch required. Elaine, prep the release note snippet.

Priya: on it. short note: "Pausing rollout after canary instability in us-west; investigating kernel-level regression; hotpatch in progress; customers unaffected so far."

Elaine: release note draft ready, will attach rollback steps and link to postmortem skeleton.

deploybot: Hotpatch candidate PR #889 created by Miguel. Can trigger canary redeploy with `/deploy slot 6421 --hotpatch 889` once you mark ready.

Miguel: kicking off validation now. will update once canary redeploy completes.

Sam: thanks — holding wider rollout for 2 hours as contingency. if hotpatch fails, we reschedule window to tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Will update thread once we have canary results. :thumbsup:
